benchmark_name: Madhya Pradesh Specialized Plant Pathology Benchmark (Mahua Leaf Disease Detection)

source_dataset.title: Annotated Mahua Leaf Dataset for Disease Detection and Precision Agriculture
source_dataset.funder: Madhya Pradesh Council of Science and Technology (MPCST), Govt. of Madhya Pradesh

model_architecture: PyTorch ResNet9 Backbone with Transfer Learning Feature Extractor

Healthy Leaf.description: Lustrous, leathery, dark green oblong-lanceolate leaf blade free from necrosis, leaf spots, and fungal pustules. Characteristic prominent pinnate venation intact.
Healthy Leaf.silvicultural_management: Maintain adequate tree canopy aeration, remove surrounding invasive weed competition (Lantana camara), and practice annual soil aeration in tribal agroforestry zones.

Unhealthy Leaf.causal_complex: Cercospora madhucae / Colletotrichum gloeosporioides (Anthracnose leaf spot) / Scopella kranzliniana (Mahua rust)
Unhealthy Leaf.symptoms: Circular to irregular dark brown necrotic lesions with chlorotic halos; leaf margin blighting; premature foliar senescence and shedding reducing flowering and mahua seed (tora) yield.
Unhealthy Leaf.treatment_protocol: Prune severely infested lower canopy foliage post-monsoon; apply 1% Bordeaux mixture or copper oxychloride (COC 50 WP @ 3g/L) for initial leaf spot outbreaks. For commercial plantations or nursery seedlings, foliar spray of Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP @ 2g/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1ml/L.

diseases: Yellow Mosaic Virus (transmitted by Bemisia tabaci)
Soybean (Malwa & Vindhyan Plateau).protocols: Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2 ml/L or Pyraclostrobin 20% WG @ 1 g/L for rust; Thiamethoxam 25 WG @ 0.3 g/L for whitefly vector; Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg seed (JNKVV / IISR Indore guidelines).

Wheat (Central Narmada & Malwa).protocols: Seed treatment with Carboxin 37.5% + Thiram 37.5% DS @ 2 g/kg; Prophylactic spray of Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L at first appearance of stripe/leaf rust (ICAR-IIWBR / JNKVV Powarkheda recommendations).

diseases: Fusarium Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. ciceris)
Gram / Chickpea (Bundelkhand & Malwa).protocols: Deep summer plowing; Seed treatment with Carbendazim + Thiram (1:1) @ 2g/kg; Bio-agent Trichoderma harzianum @ 10g/kg; resistant cultivars (JG-11, RVG-202) aligned with JNKVV / RVSKVV.

Mustard / Rapeseed (Gird Zone - Morena,.protocols: Foliar spray of Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2 g/L at 45-50 DAS; Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2g/L for Alternaria (RVSKVV Zonal Agricultural Research Station Morena).

diseases: Bacterial Blight / Angular Leaf Spot (Xanthomonas citri pv. malvacearum)
Cotton (Nimar Valley - Khargone, Khandwa.protocols: Copper Oxychloride 50 WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 100 mg/L for bacterial blight; Wettable Sulphur 80 WP @ 3 g/L for grey mildew (RVSKVV Cotton Research Station Khandwa).

state_agricultural_universities.JNKVV: Jawaharlal Nehru Krishi Vishwa Vidyalaya (Jabalpur) - Jurisdictions: Central Narmada Valley, Vindhyan Plateau, Kymore Plateau & Satpura Hills, Bundelkhand, Wainganga Valley, Eastern Plateau
state_agricultural_universities.RVSKVV: Rajmata Vijayaraje Scindia Krishi Vishwa Vidyalaya (Gwalior) - Jurisdictions: Malwa Plateau, Gird Northern Zone, Nimar Valley, Jhabua Hills
